judged_text: evt.destinationCalendar is set to null when neither the event type nor the organizer has a destination calendar, and the later `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` silently no-ops on null. A collective event whose organizer lacks a destination calendar but whose members have them collects the members' calendars into teamDestinationCalendars and then discards them, so no calendar event is created for any member host.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around line ~1040). For collective team events, member destination calendars are accumulated into `teamDestinationCalendars`, but then applied via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which silently no-ops when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`. This leaves `evt.destinationCalendar` null even though team members had calendars, and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates destinations when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`, so those member calendars won’t be used to create events.
